title: From Denoising Dynamics to Endpoint Uncertainty in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.35425v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predictive uncertainty in stochastic language-model inference can be characterized by repeatedly sampling an input and measuring the distribution of outputs. This requires multiple complete generations. Masked diffusion language models expose another source of information: the evolution of the output during denoising. We ask whether convergence within diffusion trajectories is associated with uncertainty across their final outputs, or endpoints. We study four masked diffusion language models on four reasoning benchmarks, collecting 20 generations per question and 32,000 denoising trajectories in total. Within each trajectory, we measure within-run concentration as the area under the curve describing stable resolution of the eventual output. Across repeated trajectories, we measure endpoint-distribution uncertainty. translated_title: 扩散语言模型中从去噪动力学到端点不确定性
translated_abstract: 随机语言模型推理中的预测不确定性通常可以通过对同一输入反复采样并测量输出的分布来刻画，但这需要多次完整的生成过程。掩码扩散语言模型提供了另一种信息来源：输出在去噪过程中的演化。我们探究扩散轨迹内部的收敛是否与最终输出（即端点）的不确定性相关。我们在四个推理基准上研究了四个掩码扩散语言模型，每个问题收集20次生成，共收集了32,000条去噪轨迹。在每条轨迹内部，我们以描述最终输出稳定解析过程的曲线下面积来衡量运行内集中度；在多次重复轨迹之间，我们测量端点分布的不确定性。结果表明，在控制模型和数据集因素后，更强的运行内集中度与更低的端点熵相关……
tldr: 该研究揭示了掩码扩散语言模型去噪轨迹内部的收敛程度（运行内集中度）与其最终输出端点的不确定性呈显著负相关，从而无需多次完整生成即可通过去噪动力学过程预测模型的不确定性。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that within-run concentration during denoising trajectories in masked diffusion language models is negatively associated with endpoint uncertainty, enabling uncertainty estimation from denoising dynamics without requiring multiple complete generations.
